name: eventwatch
description: Show and publish your events from your WordPress site.

scripts.plugin-zip: wp-scripts plugin-zip && zip -dq eventwatch.zip eventwatch/package.json eventwatch/README.md
scripts.i18n: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/eventwatch sh -c 'wp i18n make-pot . languages/eventwatch.pot --exclude=src,tests,vendor,node_modules && wp i18n update-po languages/eventwatch.pot && wp i18n make-mo languages && wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge'
scripts.i18n:check: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/eventwatch wp eval-file tests/check-translations.php
scripts.test:php:multisite: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/eventwatch env WP_MULTISITE=1 vendor/bin/phpunit
